text:
elaine.pm: kick off PRD thread for Private Deployment v2 — focus: customer-managed networking (VPC & on-prem). want clear launch criteria + acceptance tests so sales/solutions can quote. sketch below. please review and flag gaps.

raj.eng: thanks. can you confirm target customer profile? big enterprises with BGP eBGP? or SMBs with static routes?

elaine.pm: primary = mid+enterprise with customer-managed egress, some on-prem air-gapped customers as secondary. we should support both static route and BGP handshakes.

kevin.sre: important edge case: customer NAT + overlapping CIDRs. need explicit hairpinning docs and default SNAT behavior. also MTU handling for jumbo frames may be required.

sophie.sec: must include KMS integration requirements (customer key wrap or HSM), audit logging to customer syslog/S3, and RBAC for control-plane operations. CANNOT ship without proof of key separation.

elaine.pm: agreed. rough acceptance checklist (draft):
```
- Customer can establish control-plane TLS mTLS to private control endpoint
- Data plane traffic routes via customer-provided IGW/NGW or BGP session
- Fallback: documented and automated fallback to hosted model variant if capacity/unavailable
- DNS: split-horizon support + ability to configure resolvers at install time
- KMS: support bring-your-own-key (AWS KMS, Vault HSM) for model keys and logs
- Audit: configurable syslog endpoint + 90d object retention option
- Perf: 95th p99 latency delta <= 20% vs hosted baseline under same load profile
- E2E tests: provisioning, scale-up, and failover tests in CI against a sandbox customer network
```

maria.pm: for launch criteria, suggest gating on: 3 pilot customers (1 on VPC, 1 on on-prem with static routes, 1 with BGP), successful security review, and runbook + ops playbook completed.

raj.eng: implementation notes: we need a network agent that can run in customer VPC (IAM minimal) and in on-prem datacenter (systemd service). agent responsibilities: route advertisements, health pings, KV cache sync. propose proto: agent <-> control plane uses mTLS + signed JWT for auth.

kevin.sre: add edge-case: customer with no outbound internet (air-gapped). require an offline bundle with models and local registry + a local control-plane shim that can be periodically synced via USB or secure transfer. This is heavy but some customers will require it.

sophie.sec: compliance question: do we need FIPS-certified crypto for certain customers? if yes, call it out as a non-blocking opt-in feature for launch 1.0 and plan FIPS roadmap.

elaine.pm: noted. we'll mark FIPS as backlog item but design must not preclude it. also we need acceptance test definitions for "fallback to hosted" — what counts as acceptable fallback (latency penalty, data-plane vs control-plane)?

raj.eng: propose fallback policy: prioritized by data-sensitivity tag. for non-sensitive requests -> automated cross-region hosted fallback with token scrubbing. for sensitive -> fail closed and surface 503 to client. add feature flag per-tenant.

kevin.sre: ops runbook items: certificate rotation, emergency revoke, BGP flap detection and auto-suppression, escalation path to on-call infra. we need automated postmortem hooks that capture control-plane traces.

maria.pm: stakeholder ask: Solutions team needs a one-pager with network topology templates (VPC peering, Transit GW, on-prem with firewall rules) for quoting. can eng-platform own the template + sample configs?

raj.eng: yes, we'll draft templates. need input on default port ranges and health-check endpoints. my suggestion: control-plane over 8443 (mTLS), data-plane over dynamic ephemeral ports with documented ranges.

elaine.pm: rough timeline proposal: 2 sprints design + RFC, 4 sprints implementation + pilots, 2 sprints polish + security review. pilot kickoff once 3 pilot customers signed.

sophie.sec: I'll start security checklist and threat model. will add MUST/SHOULD/MAY tags for acceptance criteria.

infra-bot: CI job private-deploy/smoke-tests started for sandbox-3 (logs will post in #eng-cicd).

elaine.pm: next action items: (1) raj: create RFC doc draft with architecture diagrams and agent API by EOW; (2) kevin: draft ops runbook skeleton and failure modes; (3) sophie: security checklist and KMS/HSM requirements; (4) maria: confirm pilot customer commitments. please ping when done.

raj.eng: ack, will draft and include sequence diagrams.

kevin.sre: ack, will add BGP flap sim scripts for CI.

sophie.sec: ack, starting threat model now.

maria.pm: ack, following up with sales.

elaine.pm: thanks all — we'll reconvene next Tue for RFC review. :calendar:
